title: Order Management
summary: Reconcile approved order, inventory and fulfillment exports and prepare exception work for the order owner.

inputs.label: Order reconciliation
inputs.description: One row per order line joined by the source owner from approved order, inventory and fulfillment exports; quantities use the same unit and date snapshot. Shipment updates remain drafts.

connections.name: Order management and warehouse exports
prerequisites: Workspace-scoped read-only order and inventory exports
Named order owner and approved retention period
Source owner verifies order-line joins, units, stock snapshot and fulfillment status

sample_goal: Find the short allocation, over-shipment and open overdue order in four synthetic order lines.
deliverable: Order exception worklist with source-linked customer-update preparation
acceptance: Findings name the order line and source snapshot
Quantity checks compare the same units
Completed orders do not generate open-order deadline findings
Customer promises and outgoing updates require owner review
stop_conditions: Stop for unverified order-line joins or stock snapshots
Escalate conflicting fulfillment evidence before drafting delivery promises

rules.title: Allocated quantity covers the order
rules.action: Ask the order owner to review stock availability and fulfillment options.

rules.title: Shipped quantity does not exceed the order
rules.action: Reconcile shipment evidence with the order before an update or correction.

rules.title: Open order passed its ship-by date
rules.action: Prepare a delayed-order update from verified shipment evidence for review.

rules.title: Customer-update owner is assigned
rules.action: Assign a responsible person to review the proposed customer update.

title: Inventory Planning
summary: Compare approved stock and demand assumptions with lead-time needs and maximum stock targets to prepare replenishment decisions.

inputs.label: Stock and demand planning inputs
inputs.description: One row per SKU/location. Source owners supply available units, lead-time demand and maximum stock targets in one unit; this workflow checks these assumptions and does not forecast demand.

connections.name: Inventory, demand and supplier planning exports
prerequisites: Workspace-approved inventory snapshot and demand plan
Planner verifies lead-time demand calculation and safety-stock policy
Approved supplier directory and read-only lead-time evidence

sample_goal: Find one stockout risk, one excess-stock risk and one missing supplier in a synthetic inventory plan.
deliverable: Inventory risk worklist and replenishment proposal inputs
acceptance: Stockout findings cite available units and approved lead-time demand
Excess-stock findings cite the approved maximum target
Every exception retains source evidence and an owner action
No purchase order or supplier commitment is created
stop_conditions: Stop for mixed units, stale snapshots or unsupported demand assumptions
Escalate conflicting supplier lead times to the planner

rules.title: Stock covers approved lead-time demand
rules.action: Prepare replenishment review using approved demand and lead-time assumptions.

rules.title: Stock remains within the approved maximum
rules.action: Ask the planner to review transfer, demand or replenishment adjustments.

rules.title: Replenishment supplier is identified
rules.action: Resolve the approved supplier and lead-time evidence before purchasing review.

title: Logistics Exceptions
summary: Review shipment milestones, delivery quantities and proof-of-delivery evidence to prepare resolution options.

inputs.label: Shipment exception evidence
inputs.description: One row per shipment from an approved carrier/warehouse export. The POD field is an evidence reference, not a document fetched by this workflow. Quantity reconciliation is limited to supplied delivery records.

connections.name: Carrier and transport-management exports
prerequisites: Authorized read-only shipment and milestone exports
Verified shipment identifiers and quantity units
Named carrier-contact owner and separate correspondence authority

sample_goal: Find an unresolved delivery deadline, missing proof and quantity discrepancy while leaving the reconciled shipment clear.
deliverable: Shipment exception register with draft resolution actions
acceptance: Open deadline exceptions are distinguished from completed deliveries
Proof-of-delivery gaps name the missing evidence
Quantity discrepancies retain shipped and delivered quantities with citations
A human logistics owner reviews resolution options
stop_conditions: Stop for conflicting carrier identifiers or unverified snapshots
Escalate suspected loss, hazardous cargo or safety incidents to qualified owners

rules.title: Open shipment exception passed its delivery date
rules.action: Prepare milestone and carrier-evidence questions for the logistics owner.

rules.title: Proof of delivery is available
rules.action: Prepare an evidence request for the authorized carrier-contact owner.

rules.title: Delivered quantity matches shipped quantity
rules.action: Assemble shipment and receipt evidence for shortage or over-delivery review.

title: Quality Operations
summary: Review defect and complaint records for missing investigation evidence, repeat identifiers and overdue corrective actions.

inputs.label: Defects and corrective actions
inputs.description: Approved structured defect/complaint and corrective-action export. Human reviewers supply classifications and investigation references; this workflow checks completeness and deadlines.

connections.name: Quality-management records export
prerequisites: Workspace-scoped read-only quality or complaint export
Quality owner verifies classifications and corrective-action links
Retention rules and handling restrictions for complaints

sample_goal: Find missing investigation evidence, an overdue action and a repeated defect reference in a synthetic quality review.
deliverable: Quality evidence and corrective-action review worklist
acceptance: Findings preserve defect and complaint references
All duplicate members are listed without deletion
Closed actions do not generate deadline findings
No product disposition or safety certification is implied
stop_conditions: Escalate safety-related complaints to the quality owner
Stop when defect identifiers or action ownership cannot be reconciled

rules.title: Investigation evidence is linked
rules.action: Ask the quality owner to supply investigation evidence before disposition review.

rules.title: Open corrective action is overdue
rules.action: Prepare an overdue corrective-action review for the quality owner.

rules.title: Defect reference is unique in this review
rules.action: Review repeated records while preserving source history before proposing deduplication.

title: Maintenance Planning
summary: Review preventive-maintenance deadlines, qualified reviewers and inspection evidence to prepare a maintenance schedule.

inputs.label: Maintenance and inspection register
inputs.description: Asset-level maintenance export with approved due dates, inspection references and assigned qualified reviewers. Safety decisions and physical work remain with qualified personnel.

connections.name: Asset and maintenance-system exports
prerequisites: Read-only asset export with verified identifiers
Qualified supervisor owns prioritization and safety decisions
Approved maintenance intervals and inspection evidence retention

sample_goal: Flag near-term maintenance, an unassigned qualified reviewer and missing inspection evidence across synthetic assets.
deliverable: Preventive-maintenance preparation list with evidence gaps
acceptance: Due-within-seven-days findings preserve asset and due-date evidence
Missing qualified reviewers are explicit exceptions
Completed work is excluded from upcoming maintenance
The schedule is a proposal without equipment-operation authority
stop_conditions: Escalate safety-critical findings to qualified personnel
Stop for conflicting asset identities or maintenance intervals

rules.title: Open maintenance falls within seven days
rules.action: Prepare work for supervisor scheduling and qualified safety review.

rules.title: Qualified reviewer is assigned
rules.action: Assign a qualified reviewer before prioritizing or authorizing maintenance.

rules.title: Inspection evidence is linked
rules.action: Request the approved inspection record for supervisor review.

title: Construction Project Controls
summary: Review RFIs, submittals and change requests against decision dates, referenced drawings and assigned project owners.

inputs.label: Project decision and document register
inputs.description: Approved RFI, submittal and change-request export with human-verified schedule dates and document references. No design adequacy or construction safety determination is made.

connections.name: Construction document-control export
prerequisites: Project-scoped read-only document register
Project manager verifies drawing revisions and required decision dates
Authorized technical and commercial reviewers

sample_goal: Find an overdue RFI, undocumented change request and unassigned submittal while preserving a closed item.
deliverable: Project controls exception and decision packet
acceptance: Exceptions retain item type, identifier and source
Open decisions due within three days are surfaced
Closed items do not create deadline findings
Technical responses and commitments remain for authorized review
stop_conditions: Stop if drawing revisions or project scope are uncertain
Escalate engineering, safety and contractual interpretation to qualified reviewers

rules.title: Open project decision is due within three days
rules.action: Prepare the pending decision and schedule-impact evidence for the project manager.

rules.title: Drawing or scope evidence is referenced
rules.action: Resolve current drawing or change-scope evidence before response review.

rules.title: Decision owner is assigned
rules.action: Assign the authorized reviewer for the pending project item.

title: Property Operations
summary: Prepare maintenance, lease-obligation and inspection follow-through from approved property operations records.

inputs.label: Property operations register
inputs.description: Property-scoped work-order, inspection and lease-obligation export without tenant eligibility or screening information. Human-reviewed obligation dates and required vendor-document references are inputs.

connections.name: Property-management records export
prerequisites: Read-only portfolio export restricted to authorized properties
Authorized reviewer verifies lease obligations and deadlines
Exclude screening, protected traits and adverse-decision data

sample_goal: Find an overdue property obligation, missing vendor document and unassigned inspection follow-through.
deliverable: Property follow-through worklist and evidence gaps
acceptance: Items retain property, type and evidence reference
Completed items do not generate deadline findings
Vendor-document and inspection-ownership gaps remain explicit
No tenant eligibility or adverse decision is made
stop_conditions: Escalate urgent safety or habitability concerns to the property manager
Stop if inputs require tenant eligibility or adverse decisions
blocked_actions: Make tenant eligibility or adverse decisions

rules.title: Open property obligation is overdue
rules.action: Prepare the obligation and supporting record for property-manager review.

rules.title: Required vendor paperwork is linked
rules.action: Request required vendor evidence through the authorized property owner.

rules.title: Follow-through owner is assigned
rules.action: Assign an owner to track maintenance or inspection follow-through.

title: Grant Operations
summary: Check opportunity and reporting packets against supplied funder criteria, deadlines and required evidence.

inputs.label: Grant opportunity and reporting requirements
inputs.description: One row per application or report for a single funder criterion set. Source owners supply published accepted applicant categories and verify packet deadlines and evidence. This workflow does not search for opportunities or infer legal eligibility.

inputs.label: Published accepted applicant categories
inputs.description: One unique category per row from one funder criterion set verified by the grants owner. A match is a category check, not full eligibility certification.

connections.name: Published funder and grant-management exports
prerequisites: Approved funder notice and read-only grant-management export
Grants owner verifies criterion transcription, applicant categories and deadline timezone
Named authorized signatory and finance reviewer

sample_goal: Find a category mismatch, a near-term submission and missing budget evidence in synthetic grant packets.
deliverable: Grant requirement and reporting readiness worklist
acceptance: Category matching uses explicitly supplied accepted categories
Deadline findings cite the published requirement
Missing budget evidence is escalated before submission review
Applications and certifications require an authorized signatory
stop_conditions: Stop where eligibility requires interpretation or source dates conflict
Escalate unsupported financial or program certifications

rules.title: Applicant category is accepted by the supplied funder criterion
rules.action: Ask the grants owner to review the stated applicant category against the published criterion.

rules.title: Unsubmitted packet is due within fourteen days
rules.action: Prepare outstanding packet requirements and the responsible signatory for review.

rules.title: Budget or expenditure evidence is linked
rules.action: Obtain finance-reviewed budget or expenditure evidence before approval.

title: Training & Certification Operations
summary: Review assigned role requirements, completion evidence and certificate expiry dates to prepare training plans.

inputs.label: Required learning and certification register
inputs.description: Approved role-assignment and learning export using pseudonymous worker references. Owners map required modules and certificates to roles; this workflow checks completeness and expiry.

connections.name: Learning-management and certification exports
prerequisites: Authorized read-only learning and role-requirement exports
Learning owner verifies role mapping and acceptable completion evidence
Minimum necessary employee data and approved retention

sample_goal: Find an incomplete course, expiring certificate and missing completion evidence in synthetic learning records.
deliverable: Training and certification gap worklist with proposed next steps
acceptance: Course gaps name the supplied role and requirement
Expiring credentials are identified within thirty days
Completion assertions retain source evidence
Results are not used to make employment decisions
stop_conditions: Stop when role requirements or certificate validity cannot be verified
Escalate regulated practice authorization to qualified compliance owners

rules.title: Required learning is completed
rules.action: Prepare a completion plan for the learning owner to review.

rules.title: Credential expires within thirty days
rules.action: Prepare renewal requirements for the learning or compliance owner.

rules.title: Completion evidence is linked
rules.action: Verify completion against the approved learning or certification record.

title: Product Feedback Operations
summary: Review source-linked, human-tagged feedback themes and prioritization inputs before a product owner sets priorities.

inputs.label: Feedback theme and priority evidence
inputs.description: Approved support, interview and request export with source-owner supplied theme tags and priority rationale. This deterministic workflow checks those inputs and duplicate evidence; it does not invent themes or score customers.

connections.name: Support and product-research exports
prerequisites: Read-only support and research exports with consent and redaction checks
Product owner supplies theme tags and priority rationale
Stable originating feedback references across sources

sample_goal: Find an untagged item, unsupported priority proposal and repeated source item in synthetic feedback.
deliverable: Feedback theme evidence register and prioritization review exceptions
acceptance: Proposed themes retain originating feedback references
Every duplicate member is flagged to prevent double counting
Missing priority rationale remains an explicit gap
No roadmap commitment or customer-level decision is made
stop_conditions: Stop if research consent or redaction status is unknown
Escalate conflicting tags and unsupported priority rationales

rules.title: Feedback has a reviewed theme tag
rules.action: Ask the product owner to assign a theme using cited feedback.

rules.title: Priority proposal has supporting rationale
rules.action: Prepare source feedback for product-owner prioritization review.

rules.title: Originating feedback reference is unique
rules.action: Review repeated source items before counting evidence or changing priorities.

title: Content Production Operations
summary: Review content packets against approved briefs, claim evidence and editorial review status before publication decisions.

inputs.label: Content production and review register
inputs.description: Approved briefs and draft-asset metadata with claim evidence references and editorial status. This workflow prepares a review worklist; source documents and draft assets are not fetched or published.

connections.name: Content and evidence-library exports
prerequisites: Read-only approved brief and draft-asset export
Editor verifies factual sources and permitted asset rights
Named brand/legal reviewers and separate publisher authority

sample_goal: Find a draft without an approved brief, one without claim evidence and one awaiting editorial review.
deliverable: Content review packet and publication-readiness exceptions
acceptance: Assets are tied to approved brief references
Missing claim evidence is surfaced before publication review
Editorial status is preserved without granting publishing authority
Outbound assets remain drafts
stop_conditions: Stop for unsupported factual claims or unclear rights
Escalate legal or regulated claims to authorized reviewers

rules.title: Asset is linked to an approved brief
rules.action: Obtain an approved brief before expanding or routing the draft.

rules.title: Factual claim evidence is linked
rules.action: Route unsupported claims to the editor for source verification or removal.

rules.title: Editorial review is recorded
rules.action: Prepare the draft and sources for editorial review; publishing needs separate authority.

title: Business Continuity Operations
summary: Review recovery plans, contact ownership and exercise evidence against approved recovery objectives.

inputs.label: Critical-process recovery and exercise register
inputs.description: Approved business-impact and exercise export with verified objectives, measured exercise duration and next review dates. Checks do not certify recovery readiness or initiate failover.

connections.name: Continuity-plan and exercise evidence exports
prerequisites: Read-only continuity and exercise records restricted to this workspace
Qualified owners verify recovery objectives and exercise measurements
Approved handling and retention for contacts and dependencies

sample_goal: Find a recovery-objective miss, missing owner and overdue plan review across synthetic processes.
deliverable: Continuity preparedness gap register and exercise follow-up packet
acceptance: Recovery gaps compare exercise duration with the approved objective
Owner and plan-review gaps retain process evidence
Samples are not counted as live recovery tests
Recovery decisions remain with authorized incident leaders
stop_conditions: Stop for unverified recovery objectives or exercise measurements
Escalate critical dependencies and emergencies to authorized incident leaders

rules.title: Exercise recovery meets its approved objective
rules.action: Prepare exercise evidence and dependency gaps for recovery-plan owner review.

rules.title: Recovery owner is assigned
rules.action: Assign the accountable process owner before the next exercise.

rules.title: Recovery plan review is overdue
rules.action: Prepare the plan, contact tree and unresolved exercise findings for review.
